summary: The intended RMSProp replication and provided equivalence tests pass, but optimizer checkpoint/runtime group-kind identity is not fail-closed.

checks.expanded_suite_result: 6 passed; 4 expected failing subcases across the 2 adversarial tests

blockers.finding: OwnedOptimizer.load_state_dict authenticates ownership entries and RMSProp metadata but not optimizer.param_groups kind identity. A payload that changes the replicated RMSProp group to sgd or adamw loads successfully and subsequent step silently skips the RMSProp parameter and state update.
blockers.required_correction: Bind exact planned group kinds/indices in the checkpoint schema and reject mismatches before raw_load_state_dict mutates the optimizer. Preserve the live optimizer on rejection.

blockers.finding: OwnedOptimizer.step does not validate every live group kind against the plan before updates. Post-plan kind drift can be silently skipped for an empty owned group or fail only on owner ranks after earlier groups have already updated, creating rank-asymmetric collective risk.
blockers.required_correction: Validate the complete group-kind/partition identity on every step before any parameter/state mutation or collective. Unknown or changed kinds must reject uniformly on every rank.
